shell_commands: /bin/zsh -lc "rg --files specs | rg 'conversation|list'; cat .lore/test-commands.yml; cat package.json | head -100; cat src/transport/ws/validation.test.ts"

/bin/zsh -lc "cat specs/hal-engine-conversation-list/spec.md; cat src/transport/sessionResume.test.ts | head -180; cat src/transport/ws/validation.ts; cat scripts/lore-list-tests.mjs | rg -n 'spec|anchor'"

/bin/zsh -lc 'cat jest.config.js; cat src/transport/createServer.ts | head -100; cat scripts/lore-list-tests.mjs | head -100; cat src/types/sessionStore.ts | head -100; cat src/transport/wsTestSupport.ts | head -70; ls scripts/spec-links; cat AGENTS.md | head -80'
/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n 'specs/.*#' src/transport/*.test.ts | head; rg -n 'spec.*ordinal|spec anchor|@spec' scripts .lore | head -40; git diff --stat; git status --short"

/bin/zsh -lc "git show HEAD:specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md > specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md
cat >> specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md <<'EOF'

## Conversation list

- A "'`list_conversations` request accepts an optional integer `limit` from 1 to 200 and an optional `before` cursor with a parseable `updatedAt` and `sessionId`; invalid fields are rejected and extra fields are ignored. ([validated by: validates list requests and their composite cursor](../../src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts#L38))
- When history is enabled, a request returns only the authenticated connection user'"'s conversation metadata, newest first, with ISO timestamps and no content; paging is passed to the store, the current conversation is included, and no list is pushed unsolicited. ([validated by: lists only the authenticated user, passes paging through and sends wire summaries](../../src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts#L63))
- When history is disabled or the store cannot list, the request receives "'`UNSUPPORTED` rather than an empty list. ([validated by: reports unsupported when history is disabled or the store cannot list](../../src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts#L100))
EOF
rg -n "it'"\\('\" src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts
rg -n 'spec.*#|spec:' scripts/lore* scripts/check-spec-anchor-names.mjs | head -50"
/bin/zsh -lc "cat src/providers/mock/mockProvider.ts | head -100; cat src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts | head -90; git status -sb; rg -n 'spec' scripts/lore-list-tests.mjs"
/bin/zsh -lc "head -70 src/infrastructure/builders/promptBuilder.ts; rg -n 'createChatOrchestrator\\(' src/transport/*.test.ts | head; cat src/transport/ws/connectionHandler.ts | sed -n '95,140p'"

/bin/zsh -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
p='specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md'
s=open(p).read().replace('summaries](../../src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts#L63)', 'summaries](../../src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts#L64)')
open(p,'w').write(s)
PY
cat .gitignore | head -40
rg -n 'specs/.+#|spec:' scripts | head -30"

/bin/zsh -lc "git add .lore/dod.md src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md && git commit -m 'Define conversation list acceptance tests' && git push origin HEAD && git fetch origin main && git merge origin/main --no-edit && git push origin HEAD && git status -sb"
